title.zh: Robinhood Begins US Crypto Perps Rollout With Up to 10x Leverage
title.en: Robinhood Begins US Crypto Perps Rollout With Up to 10x Leverage

current_state.zh: Robinhood launched its US crypto perpetual futures rollout with an initial eight-contract, no-expiry lineup offering up to 10x leverage through Robinhood Derivatives and Bitstamp, with broader access planned in coming months.
current_state.en: Robinhood launched its US crypto perpetual futures rollout with an initial eight-contract, no-expiry lineup offering up to 10x leverage through Robinhood Derivatives and Bitstamp, with broader access planned in coming months.
